title: Odoo ERP for universities and schools
description: Custom Odoo modules in Python for six international universities and private schools, covering the full student lifecycle from application to graduation. Built with functional consultants, deployed on Kubernetes and maintained in production.
role: Module development in Python and the Odoo ORM, from gathering each client's requirements through to deployment and production support.

features.name: Admissions
features.description: A complete admissions module customised per institution: application forms, document upload, eligibility rules, review and approval workflow, and automatic creation of the student record on acceptance. Adapted separately for university and high-school intake, which differ in requirements and validation stages.

features.name: Tuition and fees
features.description: Tuition module handling fee structures per programme and academic year, instalment plans, invoicing, payment tracking and outstanding balances, integrated with Odoo accounting.

features.name: Accounting journals
features.description: Journal management for student financial operations, so tuition and fee entries post correctly into the institution's accounts.

features.name: Student records
features.description: Central student file: personal details, enrolment history, programme and class assignment, and document management.

features.name: Grading
features.description: Grade entry per course and assessment, weighting rules, transcripts and result publication.

features.name: Timetables
features.description: Scheduling for classes, rooms and teachers, with conflict detection.

title: eduERP
description: All-in-one platform for universities: ERP, LMS, CRM, HR, finance, billing and student records. In production with 2,000 students and 60 staff, built by a team of five.
role: Full-stack development across the platform, client requirements gathering, code review and the CI/CD pipeline.

features.name: Multi-tenancy
features.description: One platform serving several institutions, each with isolated data and its own configuration.

features.name: Academic and administrative modules
features.description: ERP, LMS, CRM, HR, finance, billing and student records in a single system, so institutions stop juggling separate tools.

features.name: Delivery pipeline
features.description: GitHub Actions running tests, builds and deployments automatically on every change.

title: This portfolio
description: Built from scratch: no frontend framework, a hand-written client-side router, and a read-only FastAPI backend serving bilingual content.
role: Everything — frontend, API, documentation and deployment.

features.name: Hand-written router
features.description: Hash-based routing with parameterised routes, so refreshes and the back button work on static hosting without a framework.

features.name: Python REST API
features.description: FastAPI serves every content endpoint in English and French, with typed query parameters and OpenAPI documentation generated from the code.

features.name: Graceful degradation
features.description: If the API is unreachable, the frontend falls back to the same JSON files served statically, so the site stays fully readable.

features.name: Bilingual by design
features.description: Content is duplicated per locale and the API falls back to English when a translation is missing, so a partial translation never breaks a page.
